Taskmaster-2 (TM-2-2020)

Kyu-Young Kim and Andy Cedilnik, Google LLC.

Source: https://github.com/google-research-datasets/Taskmaster/tree/d92cb6af3005f1dc09c39e75e7daf4a04905e00b/TM-2-2020

Changes: Syntropy's parity corpus (parity-corpus-v1 and later) uses selected
dialogs. Their turns are mapped to user and assistant roles, consecutive turns
by one speaker are joined, and each conversation is rendered with a model
family's chat template and tokenized. The dialog text is otherwise unchanged.
